'''Chefugu''' is a [[Fire]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Puffbelly]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Pyromaki]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "According to humans and Zobos alike, Chefugu smells real good. But careful not to give into temptation'''―'''a single bite could have you writhing on the ground from toxins."

Chefugu is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Chefugu's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Pyromaki]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Use [[Island Gold Rush|Energy Drink]] x20,000.
* Finish crafting 24 Bento(s) at the Bento Maker. Become the ultimate Tachelin chef!
